Subject: Request: 2-week POC extension + budget for extra tokens

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team is excited about the latency gains and the observability dashboard. We're mid-way through the scheduled two-week POC and have a few blockers on the clinical parsing tests that will take another ~10 business days to validate.

Two asks from our side:
- Can we extend the POC window by two calendar weeks? That will let our data team run the third validation round.
- If an extension isn't possible under the current trial allocation, can we purchase an incremental token/top-up (one-off) or accept a small discounted charge for the extra usage? Please advise the easiest path -- we can either sign a short addendum or have procurement issue a PO.

I've attached the current POC metrics summary so you can see where we're blocked (Northwood_POC_metrics.xlsx).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we want to keep momentum.

Best,
Claire Thompson
Head of AI, Northwood Diagnostics
claire@northwooddx.com
+1 617 555 0182


From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week POC extension + budget for extra tokens

Claire — thanks for the clear note and the metrics doc, that helps. Short answers: yes, we can do an extension; and yes, we have two practical ways to handle the extra usage. Details below and looping in Marcus (pricing) and Monica (CS) to finalize language.

Options (fast path):
1) Time-boxed extension (preferred) — add two calendar weeks to the current POC, no additional charge if total usage stays within a soft cap we agree on. If you exceed the cap, we bill overage at a pre-agreed discounted rate. We'll ship a 1-page addendum to formalize the dates and cap.
2) One-off top-up — Northwood purchases an incremental token block at a discount (we usually offer 18-22% off list for add-on top-ups during POCs). This is faster if procurement prefers a PO now.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to confirm the exact discount and overage rate so we can attach numbers to the addendum.
- Monica to confirm any changes to support / onboarding hours for the extra two weeks.
- Claire / Jordan: tell us whether procurement prefers an addendum (signature) or a PO + invoice.

I'll prepare the addendum draft once Marcus confirms the numbers.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Thanks for looping me in. Quick pricing detail here so we can move:

- Addendum approach (time-boxed):
  * Extension: +14 days to current POC period
  * Usage soft cap: additional 200k tokens included 
  * Overage: $0.0009 / token beyond the cap (25% discount off hosted list rate for trial top-ups)

- One-off token top-up:
  * 200k token pack = $180 (works out to $0.0009/token)
  * Volume discount: if Northwood commits to 500k or more across the POC, we'll move to $0.00075/token (roughly 35% off list)

I'll attach a short cheatsheet (pricing-options-cheatsheet.pdf) and a working addendum template (POC-Extension-Addendum-v1.docx). If Claire/Procurement want a PO instead of a signature, we can invoice the top-up and mark the invoice as trial extension.

Monica: are there any CS hours or engineering time we should reserve for the extra two weeks?

—Marcus Lin
Pricing & Commercial Ops
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
